title: DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing subjective safety ratings and inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics (such as negentropy and plurality size) across different racial and ethnic annotator groups (Asian, Black/African American, Latine/x, White, and Multiracial) to evaluate differences in safety and harm perception.
Aggregating and comparing conversational AI safety annotations across male and female annotator groups to identify gender-based differences and variances in subjective safety evaluations.

Analyzing safety rating distributions and annotator disagreement across different generational age groups (Gen Z, Millennial, Gen X+) to measure how age demographics impact the perception of AI conversational safety and toxicity.
